description: Retrieve real-time DevTools logs (Console, Network requests, Performance metrics). Supports errorsOnly and excludeStatic for compact debugging.

contextId.description: Optional isolated context; context tab IDs are negative

errorsOnly.description: Only return console errors/assertions and failed/4xx/5xx network requests (default: false)

excludeStatic.description: Exclude static assets (images, fonts, media, stylesheets) from network requests (default: false)

filterOrigin.description: Filter out internal extension logs/warnings (chrome-extension://*). Default: true

includeHeaders.description: Include full HTTP response headers on network requests (default: false to save tokens)
